meta.description: Full-stack e-commerce marketing strategy builder. Analyzes your product, market, and competitors, then builds a complete omnichannel marketing plan covering paid ads, SEO, email/SMS, content marketing, social media, influencer partnerships, and referral programs. Includes target audience persona, competitive landscape, channel prioritization with budget allocation, content direction, and a 90-day action plan. Works for any e-commerce platform — Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, WooCommerce, TikTok Shop, and more. No API key required.
